nodes.label: CONV-763e: Never commit/push/deploy/reset without explicit request
nodes.rationale: Assume the shared tree holds other people's uncommitted work; destructive migrations and service restarts included.

nodes.label: CONV-7fb8: READ-ONLY means READ-ONLY
nodes.rationale: No source/format/schema/DB/project-data edits, no auto-fix, no commit/push/deploy/restart during audits; report the smallest sufficient next slice and STOP.

nodes.label: CONV-eeb3: Never invent API shapes, product identities, prices, quantities, compatibility claims or workflow states
nodes.rationale: Verify fixes with relevant tests and report exact failures rather than describing them as pre-existing without evidence.

nodes.label: CONV-9538: One designated continuity owner writes canonical .lore state
nodes.rationale: All agents may read/query .lore; subagents return evidence/reports; no parallel overlapping Lore writes or concurrent init/sync/compress.

nodes.label: CONV-0e80: Once-per-session continuity bootstrap, smallest delta
nodes.rationale: Read SUMMARY, query relevant scope, inspect tree state, classify delta as KNOWN/VALID/STALE/NEW, work the smallest delta; do not re-bootstrap mid-session unless state materially changes.

nodes.label: CONV-a173: Reuse prior evidence instead of rerunning oracles
nodes.rationale: Reuse prior test/audit/runtime/Playwright/benchmark evidence when inputs and dependencies are materially unchanged and cover the current assertion; check Lore and authoritative scripts before rerunning.

nodes.label: CONV-2be5: Reconcile a VERIFIED slice into .lore
nodes.rationale: Record architecture, decisions, conventions, blockers, superseded conclusions, limitations and verified outcomes; never store transient chain-of-thought or full logs; uncertainty stays uncertainty.

nodes.label: CONV-9f31: Fire Alarm brand/pre-sales policy is FIRE ALARM ONLY
nodes.rationale: Never auto-apply the Farenhyt/Gamewell/Gent strategy to CCTV, PA/VA, Access Control or other systems. Any Fire Alarm brand selection, matching, RFQ, commercial BOM or costing must apply the Brand Strategy layer BEFORE selecting products and must not jump from project requirements straight to product matching.

nodes.label: CONV-2ad4: Supplier solutions are never auto-approved; preliminary SLC allocation is an assumption
nodes.rationale: Engineer review is required before the approved BOM, and a preliminary loop/panel allocation must always be labelled an assumption rather than presented as final detailed design. Existing NOTIFIER knowledge and prior Fire Alarm work are never deleted on introduction of the Brand Strategy layer.
